rulings.restated: Enter the amount from person helper "This person's nondeductible traditional IRA contributions for 2025 (Form 8606 line 1)".
rulings.model: The IRS line 1 instructions say to include repayments of qualified reservist distributions and to subtract worksheet line 12 "or the amount you chose to deduct on Schedule 1 (Form 1040), line 20, if less"; the helper uses only worksheet line 12 and omits those items.
rulings.ruling: Ruling: scope; f8606 p. 9: reservist repayments are refused (scope.reservist_repaid); the deduction is the tool's own Schedule 1 line 20 path. Project stands.
